baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence attaches to qulubihim, marad, irtabu, yakhafuna, yahifa, and al-zalimun in 24:50.
baseline_models.mechanism: The questions move from a damaged faculty of judgment, through epistemic disturbance, to motivated expectation of biased judgment; bal then shifts attention from proposed inner states to their active withholding of right.

activation_trace.role: The heart-and-understanding image locates the diagnosis in the faculty that apprehends and decides.
Departure from health and balance supplies impairment of that deciding faculty.
Disturbed doubt converts impairment into unstable appraisal and suspicion.
Expected harm turns suspicion into an affective forecast of loss.
Judicial leaning names the feared outcome as partiality in judgment.
Withholding or blocking a right relocates the operative injustice in the claimants themselves.

changed_reading.before: Three independent questions merely speculate about what may be wrong inside them.
changed_reading.after: An ordered diagnostic moves from impaired judgment to doubt to self-protective suspicion, then refuses their projection by naming their own rights-blocking agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The model is anchored in marad, irtabu, yakhafuna, and yahifa in 24:50.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disease can weaken an undertaking and stop motion short, while another branch describes nearing correctness without reaching it; doubt and anticipated adverse judgment then keep deliberation from maturing into assent.

activation_trace.role: Weakening and shortened movement make disease a failure to carry a decision through.
Near-accuracy without arrival supplies the image of approaching a sound judgment but not reaching it.
Oscillating suspicion destabilizes the incomplete movement.
Expected harm supplies the brake that arrests resolution.
The imagined tilt of judgment gives the stalled decision its stated rationale.

changed_reading.before: Disease, doubt, and fear are mutually exclusive labels.
changed_reading.after: They can form one arrested process: weakened resolve approaches judgment, suspicion destabilizes it, and fear of an adverse tilt stops assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material contrast is anchored in yahifa alayhim and the reversal to al-zalimun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The feared wrong is imagined as adjudication shaving something from their side, but the closing label answers with their own misplacement and withholding of rights; the accusation is structurally projected and returned.

activation_trace.role: Taking from edges renders feared unfairness as erosion of their claimed portion.
Putting a thing outside its proper place makes their own claim-position the spatial disorder.
Withholding a right identifies the actual deprivation as something they perform.
Turning an object from one face to another supports the verse's return of the charge upon its speakers.

changed_reading.before: They fear a generally unfair verdict.
changed_reading.after: They imagine their interest being trimmed at its edge, while bal turns the geometry around: they are the ones displacing and withholding right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with bounded obligation, later describes settlement without shortfall and a fixed right, and then exposes attendance only when that owned right favors them. These measures answer the focus image of edge-taking and turn fear of unfairness into outcome-selective projection.

activation_trace.role: Edge-taking supplies the focus fear that adjudication will reduce their portion.
A precisely bounded obligation supplies a legal order marked by known limits.
Completion without deficiency directly counters the imagined shaving of an entitlement.
Fixed obligation and entitlement stabilize what is due against arbitrary tilt.
An owned right becomes the condition under which the evasive party readily approaches.
Misplacing a thing identifies selective acceptance, not the measured order, as the distortion.

structural_cues: 24:2-10 regulates accusation, evidence, oath, and consequence rather than leaving judgment unbounded.
24:25 promises full settlement, while 24:49 says the party comes when the right is theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded duty, full payment, and a right approached only when favorable; I infer that procedural completeness answers the feared edge-loss. A live alternative is that these are separate legal topics and the focus only charges generic hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: Their fear could be a reasonable concern that authority will diminish a legitimate claim.
changed_reading.after: The surah's measured legal field makes diminution the projected pretext of litigants who accept jurisdiction only when a fixed right is already theirs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first demands knowledgeable external testimony and later makes speech-organs and acting limbs testify. The focus's inward questions therefore sit inside an evidentiary discipline: hidden condition is inferred through embodied conduct, especially the selective behavior in 24:47-49.

activation_trace.role: The inward faculty is the apparently hidden object that requires a visible trace.
Testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge establishes the surah's evidentiary threshold.
The witnessing-tongue image moves evidence from outside observers into the person's own body.
The speech organ literalizes self-produced evidence rather than unsupported mind-reading.
The hand-as-earned-action image makes conduct itself testify to the inward orientation.
The final active withholding supplies the behavioral verdict reached from those traces.

structural_cues: 24:4 requires witnesses for accusation; 24:24 makes tongues, hands, and feet testify to deeds.
24:47-49 displays profession, withdrawal, and selective submission immediately before the diagnostic questions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an external-to-embodied testimony sequence and observable selective conduct; I infer that the focus diagnoses the heart from enacted evidence. A live alternative is that divine knowledge alone grounds the diagnosis and the testimony sequence need not govern this verse.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts an inaccessible moral pathology without showing how it is known.
changed_reading.after: The questions function forensically: the surah trains the reader to see speech and movement as the body's testimony to a rights-blocking heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Around the focus, profession is followed by turning the back, presenting the side, and approaching submissively only for a favorable right; true hearing then means compliance, while the closing section extends avoidance into secret slipping under cover. Disease as shortened motion becomes strategic locomotion toward and away from judgment.

activation_trace.role: Weakening and curtailed movement let the focus disease describe failure to complete an approach to judgment.
Turning away literalizes withdrawal after verbal assent.
Showing one's side supplies a bodily geometry of refusal when called to judgment.
The party reverses course when an owned right favors them.
Submission becomes easy when the expected outcome is advantageous.
Hearing as understanding-and-compliance supplies the healthy counter-movement.
Slipping out extends overt withdrawal into covert exit.
Hiding behind another supplies cover for the evasive movement.
Withholding right names the stable agency beneath the changing directions.

structural_cues: 24:47-51 forms a tight sequence of saying, turning, being called, conditional coming, hearing, and obeying.
24:63 closes the surah with people secretly slipping away under cover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated directional asymmetry keyed to favorable right; I infer a single strategy of selective jurisdiction rather than unrelated motions. A live alternative is genuine fluctuating anxiety, but 24:49 makes advantage the explicit switch.

changed_reading.before: Heart disease is a static hidden condition that causes refusal.
changed_reading.after: It appears as a repeatable movement policy: approach authority for gain, turn a side to it for risk, and finally slip away while continuing to withhold right.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere fear faces a day when hearts and sights turn, and obedience is paired with awe and self-protection; later fear is exchanged for security. The focus does not abolish fear but exposes its malformed object and function: danger is projected onto the just judge instead of located in one's own evasion.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm supplies the malformed fear that treats just adjudication as danger.
Fear is legitimately directed toward a day of accountability rather than toward judicial partiality.
The turning of hearts makes accountability, not loss of advantage, the destabilizing prospect.
Awe-inflected fear supplies the proper affective orientation toward God.
Putting oneself under protection turns fear into disciplined self-guarding.
Fear that is exchanged for security shows it can be transformed rather than indulged as suspicion.

structural_cues: 24:37 directs fear toward the day of overturned hearts and sights.
24:52 joins obedience, awe, guarding, and success; 24:55 moves fear into security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct fear-configurations; I infer that 24:50 criticizes a reversal of fear's object and work. A live alternative is that yakhafuna is only another rhetorical synonym for doubt, without a wider affective correction.

changed_reading.before: Fear itself is evidence of their pathology.
changed_reading.after: Fear is morally redirected: proper fear produces guarded obedience, whereas their fear casts the judge as threat and protects only a preferred outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, falsehood turns something from its face, weather is diverted, night and day are turned, hearts turn, and the litigants turn away. The focus's heart-root and bal participate in this directional field: they invert justice into threat, and the verse counter-turns the charge onto them.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing from face to face makes the heart a directional faculty, not only an organ.
Falsehood as turning from the proper face supplies the model of moral inversion.
Diversion from one state to another distinguishes legitimate divine turning from evasive human turning.
The explicit turning of night and day establishes controlled reversal as an intelligible surah-wide mechanism.
The faction's turning away enacts inward inversion as bodily direction.
Misplacement is the resulting condition when justice and threat exchange places.

structural_cues: 24:11, 24:37, 24:43-44, and 24:47 repeatedly stage turning, diversion, or reversal.
The focus moves through three alternatives and then uses bal to reverse the accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated turnings with different agents and moral values; I infer that the focus distinguishes legitimate transformation from self-serving inversion. A live alternative is that the repetitions are thematic texture rather than a specific mechanism in 24:50.

changed_reading.before: Their heart contains a static disease and their accusation is simply false.
changed_reading.after: Their heart is directionally inverted: it turns justice into predation, while bal turns that projection back into a verdict of misplaced right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes acquittal from healing and later explicitly removes constraint from the bodily sick. That legal mercy prevents the focus's disease-question from operating as a deterministic excuse; bal reattaches responsibility to active injustice.

activation_trace.role: Departure from health supplies the diagnostic category that might otherwise seem exculpatory.
Acquittal as separation from a charge distinguishes legal innocence from mere pathology.
Literal illness receives relief, showing that sickness itself is not treated as wrongdoing.
Removal of constriction supplies the merciful legal treatment of incapacity.
The branch linking lateral inclination to culpable fault helps separate exempt limitation from sinful leaning.
The closing active withholding, not disease alone, bears the verdict.

structural_cues: 24:26 explicitly clears people of what is said about them.
24:61 repeats that there is no constraint on the blind, lame, or sick and no blame in the regulated social act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legal acquittal and an explicit sickness exemption; I infer that the focus's pathology cannot by itself excuse selective injustice. A live alternative is that moral disease and culpability coexist, so bal may intensify rather than reject the diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Calling the heart diseased fully explains and fixes their culpability.
changed_reading.after: Disease is floated as diagnosis but not accepted as legal incapacity; responsibility attaches to the enacted choice to misplace and withhold right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus couples God and messenger as the imagined agents of unfairness, but 24:54 allocates distinct burdens, makes obedience a path to guidance, and limits the messenger's charge to delivery. This constrains the suspicion: the carrier does not invent or appropriate the right he conveys.

activation_trace.role: The carrier-of-message image identifies the human channel implicated by their suspicion.
Judicial leaning is the unfair agency they project onto both source and messenger.
Repeated messenger language keeps the role tied to carrying a communicated charge.
Bearing an entrusted obligation distributes responsibility between messenger and addressees.
Gentle direction toward the right makes obedience directional guidance rather than confiscation.
Delivery of the message bounds the messenger's assigned function.

structural_cues: 24:48 calls them to God and the messenger for judgment; 24:54 later separates what each party bears.
24:54 states that the messenger's responsibility is clear delivery and that obedience leads to guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden-allocation, guidance, and bounded delivery; I infer that these limit how the messenger can be imagined as a self-interested taker. A live alternative is that 24:54 clarifies mission generally without narrowing his adjudicative role in 24:50.

changed_reading.before: God and messenger appear as a fused authority whose verdict might arbitrarily take from them.
changed_reading.after: Their suspicion contaminates the transmission channel: the messenger bears and delivers a charge, while they evade the burden that remains theirs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light-to-mirage sequence contrasts illumination with desire-driven misrecognition: a thirsty estimator takes appearance for water, finds nothing, and reaches reckoning. Disease as dimmed clarity and doubt in the heart can therefore make impartial judgment look like predation because advantage has become the criterion of reality.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding supplies the inner perceptual faculty under examination.
Darkening and reduced clarity turn disease into impaired moral optics.
Unstable suspicion is the epistemic symptom of those impaired optics.
Repeated illumination supplies the positive condition for seeing and judging truly.
A waterlike shimmer supplies a desired but false appearance.
Supposition links mistaken estimation to the verse's later reckoning cluster.
Finding first nothing and then the true encounter reverses apparent possession into accountability.
Failed eye-and-insight perception supplies the endpoint of layered obscuration.

structural_cues: 24:35-40 moves from layered light to mirage, failed finding, layered darkness, and failed seeing.
24:46 places clear signs and a straight path immediately before the profession-and-withdrawal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained perceptual contrast; I infer that the focus's inner pathology adopts its optics and mistakes unfavorable truth for injustice. A live alternative is that the images characterize disbelief broadly and do not specifically gloss adjudicative opportunism.

changed_reading.before: Their doubt is an abstract intellectual uncertainty about the judge.
changed_reading.after: It is interested misperception: the heart treats favorable outcome as water and therefore sees any truth that frustrates thirst as a threatening tilt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates two distant branches under the niche-root in 24:35 and transfers their vessel mechanics to the focus heart. It remains anchored in qulubihim and marad and in the packet's paired niche, illness, and light branches, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a claim that the niche word lexically means disease in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qulubihim and marad provide the diseased receptacle; the light passage supplies a niche that can either house illumination or activate an illness branch.

activation_trace.role: The heart supplies the inward receptacle whose functioning is at issue.
Loss of clarity makes pathology a failure to transmit or preserve illumination.
The lamp-niche image supplies a bounded vessel intended to hold light.
The same root inventory's illness image activates a damaged-vessel analogy.
Illumination supplies what the healthy inward vessel should receive and disclose.

changed_reading.before: Heart disease is only a moral-medical label.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heart is a damaged light-receptacle: the problem is not missing information but failure to house illumination, so just judgment is experienced as threat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins cutting, edges, middles, fitted rights, and misplacement into a material geometry of adjudication. It remains anchored in yahifa and al-zalimun and uses branch-backed legal-context roots, but downstream prose should qualify it as an analogical model of calibration rather than an etymological definition of justice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yahifa supplies edge-loss and al-zalimun supplies placement outside the proper location.

activation_trace.role: Taking from an edge supplies the feared deformation of a claim.
Placement outside the proper location supplies the counter-charge of bad fit.
A cut or notch supplies the image of a share marked to a determinate boundary.
A middle state between two sides supplies adjudication's calibrated position.
A right fitting its joint or vessel supplies the positive geometry of due placement.

changed_reading.before: Unfairness means an authority simply favors the other party.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, justice is calibrated fit: marked portions meet in a middle and each right seats in its place, while their fear imagines trimming and their conduct produces the actual misfit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads distant fear and recovery branches under the faction-root in the immediate context as an anatomy of the group. It remains anchored in the focus's disease and fear alternatives and in the repeated fariq occurrences, but downstream prose should mark it as wordplay-like branch activation, not as the ordinary lexical sense of faction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Marad and yakhafuna in the focus are activated by fear-of-heart and recovery-from-illness branches attached to the immediately repeated faction-root.

activation_trace.role: Disease supplies one pole of the focus's proposed inward condition.
Expected harm supplies the second pole.
Fear splitting the heart internalizes the externally named faction.
Recovery from illness makes the faction hover between pathology and possible emergence from it.
A separated group supplies the visible social form of the proposed inner split.

changed_reading.before: The faction is only a demographic subset that refuses judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its external separation mirrors a split heart suspended between fear, illness, and the unrealized possibility of recovery.

strongest_changes: The surah's bounded duties, complete settlement, and fixed rights turn feared edge-loss into projection by outcome-selective claimants.
The immediate and closing movement sequences make the inward diagnosis observable as approach for advantage, side-turning under risk, and covert exit.
Fear is not rejected but relocated from suspicion of the judge to awe, self-guarding, and accountability.
The later exemption for literal illness prevents heart-disease language from functioning as a deterministic excuse for active injustice.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction linked the focus's edge-taking and turning branches to measured entitlements, embodied testimony, repeated directional reversals, and a later sickness exemption; it also preserved the niche-pathology, material-fit, and split-faction activations with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the repeated turning roots form a deliberate mechanism for 24:50 or only a broad surah-wide texture.
How strongly the literal sickness exemption should control the metaphorical heart-disease question.
Whether the niche-pathology and faction-root outliers can survive downstream prose without being mistaken for lexical claims.
